title: Picture task photos of places
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Bringing the world together (5.1); revision begins; mock
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 30 (Picture task photos of places (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 30: 1AA0 role play and picture-based task. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Role play: the rules
points: Cover every bullet; keep answers short and clear

blocks.h: Model role play: at a restaurant

parts.text: فِي الصُّورَةِ أَرَى سُوقًا مُزْدَحِمَةً فِي مَدِينَةٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ.
عَلَى اليَمِينِ هُنَاكَ فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ، وَعَلَى اليَسَارِ مَحَلٌّ صَغِيرٌ.
يَبْدُو أَنَّ الجَوَّ حَارٌّ لِأَنَّ السَّمَاءَ صَافِيَةٌ.

box.title: Describe the picture: what I see, where things are (عَلَى اليَمِينِ / اليَسَارِ), يَبْدُو أَنَّ ..., my opinion
Describe the picture, then answer: هَلْ تُحِبُّ السَّفَرَ؟ لِمَاذَا؟

keywords.def: on the right / on the left

questions.q: Role play line: ask the receptionist if there is Wi-Fi in the room.
questions.a: هَلْ يُوجَدُ إِنْتَرْنِت فِي الغُرْفَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟

questions.q: Begin a picture description of a park.
questions.a: فِي الصُّورَةِ أَرَى حَدِيقَةً كَبِيرَةً فِيهَا أَشْجَارٌ كَثِيرَةٌ.

questions.q: Core (Group B, breakout pairs): two role plays from the booklet (hotel; shop) and one picture task with three follow-up questions; partner uses the checklist. Group A: write the picture description and answers in 120 words.
questions.a: Checklist: every prompt covered; question asked; unexpected answered; picture: what, where, inference, opinion.

questions.q: Extend: Prepare two likely unexpected questions for each Theme 2 role play and answer them.
questions.a: For example: كَمْ لَيْلَةً سَتَبْقَى؟ سَأَبْقَى ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ.

questions.q: Stretch: Add a past-tense comment to your picture task: last time I went to a market ...
questions.a: For example: فِي العُطْلَةِ المَاضِيَةِ زُرْتُ سُوقًا مِثْلَ هٰذِهِ وَاشْتَرَيْتُ تَمْرًا.
B) ask a question. ? = ask a question; ! = respond to the unexpected.

questions.q: 'In the picture I see': A) فِي الصُّورَةِ أَرَى B) يَبْدُو أَنَّ
Big question: what are the four moves of a picture description?
questions.a: What I see, where things are, an inference (يَبْدُو أَنَّ), an opinion.
